title: EvoDRC Block7 repairability first-party evidence manifest
verified_facts: Block7 M1.S.2 residual violations persist while the M1 knowledge base continues to receive new records and updates.

The iter4 leaf_0006 proposal explicitly states that one M1.S.2 local notch is 252 dbu wide while the via land plus two required clearances needs 272 dbu, so a simple legal placement is locally infeasible without merging geometry or creating another violation.
The iter5 leaf_0004 proposal explicitly trades clearing V1.M1.EN.1/M1.S.2-related violations for one declared-debt M1.S.2 violation.
The iter5 leaf_0005 proposal defers a plan that would clear 117 V1.M2.AUX.2 violations because it would introduce more than 110 new violations including M1.S.2-related debt.

The iter5 contested-unit DRC verdict records a candidate with delta_total=64 and decision=rejected_net_positive, demonstrating that proposed repairs can be rejected because global violation count worsens even when connectivity is preserved.
purpose: Bind the first-party structural witnesses used for principle adjudication. This manifest does not authorize a new experiment, method, Problem-Gate transition, P0, or GPU use.
